definitions.explanation: A physical marker along a road or path indicating direction or distance to a destination.
Figuratively, something or someone that serves as a guide in life, work, or decision-making.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{道標|みちしるべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A signpost stood along the mountain path.

examples.japanese: {道標|みちしるべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{進|すす}めば→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{迷|まよ}わない→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: If you follow the signposts, you won't get lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{街道|かいどう}→街道：14040_kaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Along the old highways, stone signposts from the Edo period still remain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ}になった。
examples.english: My mentor's words became a guiding light in my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: This book will serve as a guide for young researchers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つから→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ず、⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many students are struggling because they can't find a guiding direction for their future.

notes:
USAGE:
{道標|みちしるべ} can also be read as ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧ひょう, which is more formal and technical. The reading みちしるべ is more common in everyday and literary usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道標|みちしるべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (to follow a signpost)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ} (guide/compass in life)
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道標|みちしるべ} (stone signpost)
- {道標|みちしるべ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as a guide)

The figurative use (a guiding principle or inspiration) is poetic and common in titles of books, songs, and speeches.
